arms.transport: The upstream-supported SigNoz OTel deployment at this source pin; transitive runtime image digests must be captured before the first replay, with no different input event or sampling rules

cumulative_survivor_disposition.reason: A backup service is not a telemetry backend competitor. Both backend arms must prove the same recovery requirement; survivor omission is forbidden.

readiness_trigger.start_rule: Start as soon as all named inputs exist; no date schedules the run and no ready comparison may remain unrun

fixed_decision_rule.mandatory: Each of the six frozen cases must meet every oracle field in all three repetitions. Upstream test/E2E, native-receipt parity, project scope, broker-authority denial and clean-target recovery are mandatory gates. Source review or the synthetic fixture alone cannot qualify a winner.
fixed_decision_rule.rank: Among qualifying arms maximize exact case correctness, then minimize complete provider cost for the common native task, then median full-replay elapsed time, then peak RSS. Backend storage/retrieval costs are separately recorded. Do not compare tool-token estimates as provider savings.
fixed_decision_rule.tie: If all ranked measurements are exactly tied and both arms qualify, select the existing Grafana-stack operational path, recording equality and no claim of superior quality.
fixed_decision_rule.none_qualify: Record the role RETIRED with the scoped failure reasons; no unqualified backend is promoted and no third arm is introduced.
fixed_decision_rule.terminal: After the rule selects an arm, FINAL additionally needs the catalog verdict/evidence class/wave/next_review, each selected component's final-stack runs[] pin, its upstream-owned E2E at that pin, and invoke evidence in the measured window or the recorded role reason. Otherwise name the exact unmet condition without claiming FINAL.
fixed_decision_rule.failure_retention: Keep each failed installation, replay, restart, restore and missing-usage result; no silent retry, dropping or source-oracle change.
fixed_decision_rule.amendments: Any input correction requires an independently reviewed, hashed amendment before affected scoring. The arms, metrics and fixed rule cannot change after first replay.

protected_scope: Only disposable owned services, stores, telemetry and fictional journals. Never modify paper units, paper configuration, the sealed bundle, Monday recorders, actual broker journals, acquisition paths or another lane's runner configuration.
monday_rule: Inside the CC's heavy-E2E window use systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle. A full suite additionally needs SUITE-REQUEST and the co-op's SUITE-GO.
